reason: The $24.99 launch price works out to about $0.83 a day, and the sachets are easy to throw in a bag when I travel for work. I would only try one box, and only at the launch price.
objection: Two capsules every day is a chore, and it is made in China. I am trusting a lab report I cannot check myself, and I would not pay $29.99 when a coupon or sale somewhere else might beat it.
would_change_my_mind: A bigger discount or coupon stacked on the launch price, or a one-capsule version.
